label: Cisco SFP-10G-ZR 10GBASE-ZR 80 km
notes: Cisco 10GBASE SFP+ data sheet, Tables 4 and 5 (SFP-10G-ZR): average launch 0..+4.0 dBm, receiver overload -7.0 dBm, sensitivity -24.0 dBm at BER 1e-12 with PRBS31 and no FEC, 1530-1565 nm, 80 km on G.652 - a 24 dB budget. The -24 dBm is the non-FEC figure: Cisco also publishes -27 dBm for OTU2/OTU2e with FEC (Table 5), which is not a 10GbE link and is deliberately not used here. 10GBASE-ZR is NOT an IEEE 802.3 class - Cisco builds it to its own specification - so this row cites the vendor and must not be read as a standards limit. Maximum chromatic dispersion 1600 ps/nm is about 94 km of G.652 at 17 ps/nm/km, so 80 km is inside the dispersion limit as well as the loss budget. Connector is dual LC/PC; APC patch cords are not supported. Replace these figures with the test report for the module actually purchased before pricing a build.
